title: Common rich scenario: placement axis + ticks, ambient expiry, human message, busy burst, self-wake, internal-only, cancellation, silent end
description: All times are seconds after session start (fixture clock; no real clock/sleep). Invented data only. NO real person, weather service, location, chat, model or delivery is involved. Outcomes are pre-scripted inputs, not model responses or send results. chat_active is an EXPLICITLY SUPPLIED fact, never inferred from a finished response.
assumptions: turn_busy = one response/turn still running (busy_interval). chat_active = a human conversation ongoing across turns (chat_interval); the two are deliberately separate and overlapping so that turn_busy=false while chat_active=true can be observed.

shared.idle_definition: observed_runtime/user activity only as fixture-defined; never inferred sleep, mood, or contact need
shared.self_wake_disclaimer: self-wake plans are fixture-provided synthetic decisions, not model-generated

policies.label: fixed interval
policies.assumptions: Fixed opportunities every 300 seconds, starting at zero; placement controls execution.

policies.label: explicitly seeded/listed jittered interval
policies.assumptions: Every 300 seconds plus the listed repeating offset array; not random samples.

policies.label: event driven
policies.assumptions: Supplied human, ambient and memory arrivals propose autonomous opportunities, independently of the ordinary human reply loop. Internal outputs do not trigger themselves.

policies.label: self-scheduled one-shots
policies.assumptions: Wakes only for fixture-provided self-wake plans. Each plan fires at most once.

policies.label: idle-window trigger
policies.assumptions: One opportunity after a complete quiet observation window; sampled at fixture ticks. No inference about sleep, mood, or contact need.

policies.label: hybrid timer/event/self-wake
policies.assumptions: Combines periodic ticks, supplied events and self-wake plans into raw candidates. Coalescing is done by the placement axis, not here.

placements.label: main_skip: skip autonomous opportunities during chat_active
placements.assumptions: LAB CHOICE, not an upstream default. While chat_active is true, an autonomous opportunity targeting the main conversation is SKIPPED (audited, not executed). It does not wait.

placements.label: main_defer: coalesce and rebuild after chat_active ends
placements.assumptions: LAB CHOICE. While chat_active is true, opportunities targeting main are COALESCED into one wake at chat_active end; the packet is re-selected/rebuild at that actual start (not merely at one turn_busy end).

placements.label: independent: run in a separate autonomous session during chat_active
placements.assumptions: LAB CHOICE. Opportunities run in a separate autonomous session with its own history; NOTHING is written or injected into the main conversation. Main conversation snapshots appear only if the fixture lists explicit read-only sources.
